items.source: NOTE: This annotation can be used both at the class and at the method level. In most cases, at the method level applications will prefer to use one of the HTTP method specific variants @GetMapping, @PostMapping, @PutMapping, @DeleteMapping, or @PatchMapping.
items.translation: 注意： 此注解既可用于类级别，也可用于方法级别。在大多数情况下，在方法级别应用程序将更倾向于使用 HTTP 方法特定的变体之一：@GetMapping、@PostMapping、@PutMapping、@DeleteMapping 或 @PatchMapping。

items.source: NOTE: This annotation cannot be used in conjunction with other @RequestMapping annotations that are declared on the same element (class, interface, or method). If multiple @RequestMapping annotations are detected on the same element, a warning will be logged, and only the first mapping will be used. This also applies to composed @RequestMapping annotations such as @GetMapping, @PostMapping, etc.
items.translation: 注意： 此注解不能与同一元素（类、接口或方法）上声明的其他 @RequestMapping 注解一起使用。如果在同一元素上检测到多个 @RequestMapping 注解，将记录警告信息，并且仅使用第一个映射。此规则同样适用于组合的 @RequestMapping 注解，例如 @GetMapping、@PostMapping 等。

items.source: NOTE: When using controller interfaces (for example, for AOP proxying), make sure to consistently put all your mapping annotations — such as @RequestMapping and @SessionAttributes — on the controller interface rather than on the implementation class.
items.translation: 注意： 在使用控制器接口（例如用于 AOP 代理）时，请确保始终将所有映射注解——如@RequestMapping和@SessionAttributes——放在控制器接口上，而不是实现类上。

items.source: This is an alias for path(). For example, @RequestMapping("/profile") is equivalent to @RequestMapping(path="/profile").
items.translation: 这是 `path()` 的别名。例如，`@RequestMapping("/profile")` 等同于 `@RequestMapping(path="/profile")`。

items.source: Ant-style path patterns are also supported, e.g. "/profile/**". At the method level, relative paths, e.g., "edit" are supported within the primary mapping expressed at the type level. Path mapping URIs may contain property placeholders, e.g. "/${profile_path}", and SpEL expressions, e.g. "/profile/#{@bean.property}".
items.translation: Ant 风格的路径模式也得到支持，例如 `"/profile/**"`。在方法级别，支持相对于类型级别定义的主映射的相对路径，例如 `"edit"`。路径映射 URI 可以包含属性占位符，例如 `"/${profile_path}"`，以及 SpEL 表达式，例如 `"/profile/#{@bean.property}"`。

items.translation: 有关详细信息，请参阅path()。

items.source: If a declared media type contains a parameter, and if the "content-type" from the request also has that parameter, then the parameter values must match. Otherwise, if the media type from the request "content-type" does not contain the parameter, then the parameter is ignored for matching purposes.
items.translation: 如果声明的媒体类型包含某个参数，且请求中的`"content-type"`也包含该参数，则参数值必须匹配。否则，如果请求中的`"content-type"`不包含该参数，则该参数在匹配过程中将被忽略。

items.source: Supported at the type level as well as at the method level! When used on both levels, a combined name is derived by concatenation with "#" as separator.
items.translation: 同时在类型级别和方法级别支持！ 当在两个级别都使用时，通过以 "#" 作为分隔符进行连接来派生组合名称。

items.source: Supported at the type level as well as at the method level! When used at the type level, all method-level mappings inherit this primary mapping, narrowing it for a specific handler method.
items.translation: 同时在类型级别和方法级别支持！ 当在类型级别使用时，所有方法级别的映射都会继承此主映射，并将其针对特定的处理器方法进行细化。

items.source: NOTE: A handler method that is not mapped to any path explicitly is effectively mapped to an empty path.
items.translation: 注意：未显式映射到任何路径的处理程序方法，实际上被映射到一个空路径。

items.source: Supported at the type level as well as at the method level! When used at the type level, all method-level mappings inherit this HTTP method restriction.
items.translation: 在类型级别和方法级别均支持！ 当在类型级别使用时，所有方法级别的映射都会继承此 HTTP 方法限制。

items.source: Same format for any environment: a sequence of "myParam=myValue" style expressions, with a request only mapped if each such parameter is found to have the given value. Expressions can be negated by using the "!=" operator, as in "myParam!=myValue". "myParam" style expressions are also supported, with such parameters having to be present in the request (allowed to have any value). Finally, "!myParam" style expressions indicate that the specified parameter is not supposed to be present in the request.
items.translation: 任何环境下的格式均相同：一系列 "myParam=myValue" 风格的表达式，仅当每个此类参数都被发现具有给定值时，请求才会被映射。可以通过使用 "!=" 运算符来否定表达式，例如 "myParam!=myValue"。还支持 "myParam" 风格的表达式，此类参数必须在请求中存在（允许具有任何值）。最后，"!myParam" 风格的表达式表示指定的参数 不应 出现在请求中。

items.source: Supported at the type level as well as at the method level! When used at the type level, all method-level mappings inherit this parameter restriction.
items.translation: 在类型级别和方法级别均支持！ 当在类型级别使用时，所有方法级别的映射都会继承此参数限制。

items.source: Same format for any environment: a sequence of "My-Header=myValue" style expressions, with a request only mapped if each such header is found to have the given value. Expressions can be negated by using the "!=" operator, as in "My-Header!=myValue". "My-Header" style expressions are also supported, with such headers having to be present in the request (allowed to have any value). Finally, "!My-Header" style expressions indicate that the specified header is not supposed to be present in the request.
items.translation: 任何环境下的格式均相同：一系列"My-Header=myValue"样式的表达式，仅当每个此类表达式的头字段具有给定值时，请求才会被映射。可以使用"!="运算符对表达式进行否定，例如"My-Header!=myValue"。还支持"My-Header"样式的表达式，此类头字段必须在请求中存在（允许具有任何值）。最后，"!My-Header"样式的表达式表示指定的头字段不应出现在请求中。

items.source: Supported at the type level as well as at the method level! When used at the type level, all method-level mappings inherit this header restriction.
items.translation: 在类型级别和方法级别均支持！ 当在类型级别使用时，所有方法级别的映射都会继承此头限制。

items.source: Expressions can be negated by using the "!" operator, as in "!text/plain", which matches all requests with a Content-Type other than "text/plain".
items.translation: 表达式可以使用"!"运算符进行否定，例如"!text/plain"，它匹配所有`Content-Type`不是"text/plain"的请求。

items.source: Supported at the type level as well as at the method level! If specified at both levels, the method level consumes condition overrides the type level condition.
items.translation: 在类型级别和方法级别均支持！ 如果在两个级别都指定，方法级别的配置将覆盖类型级别的配置。

items.source: Expressions can be negated by using the "!" operator, as in "!text/plain", which matches all requests with a Accept other than "text/plain".
items.translation: 表达式可以使用"!"运算符进行否定，例如"!text/plain"，它匹配所有`Accept`头不为"text/plain"的请求。

items.source: Supported at the type level as well as at the method level! If specified at both levels, the method level produces condition overrides the type level condition.
items.translation: 在类型级别和方法级别均支持！ 如果在两个级别都指定，方法级别的配置将覆盖类型级别的配置。

items.source:
If a declared media type contains a parameter (for example, "charset=UTF-8",
"type=feed", "type=entry") and if a compatible media type from the request
has that parameter too, then the parameter values must match. Otherwise,
if the media type from the request does not contain the parameter, it is
assumed the client accepts any value.
items.translation: 如果声明的媒体类型包含一个参数（例如，"charset=UTF-8"、"type=feed"、"type=entry"），并且请求中的兼容媒体类型也包含该参数，则参数值必须匹配。否则，如果请求中的媒体类型不包含该参数，则假定客户端接受任何值。

items.source:
A baseline version allows an endpoint to continue to work in
subsequent versions if it remains compatible. When an incompatible change
is made eventually, a new controller method for the same endpoint but
with a higher version takes precedence.
items.translation: 基线版本允许端点在后续版本中保持兼容时继续工作。当最终进行不兼容的更改时，针对同一端点但具有更高版本的控制器方法将优先执行。
